review.reviewer: assistant fixed-ROI geometry selection; no speaker approval
review.attribution_basis: Fixed spatial crop of the left seated image position in a two-person wide shot. Identity and association with the audio speaker remain unknown. The requested native 65–70-second window inherits unverified first-frame alignment from the parent 60–80-second download. Face detection is sparse (7/40 frames), so this preview deliberately imports pose only.

limitations: Geometry estimates do not identify a person or establish emotional state.
Detection selection and speaker attribution are reviewer assertions, not biometric verification.
The reference frame establishes a rotation reference, not an automatically detected anatomical neutral face.
Pose landmarks outside the image or below visibility/presence 0.65 are omitted.
Limb rotations use direction-only swing; axial twist and finger articulation are not measured.
Rotations are bounded to 70 degrees relative to the reference pose.
Unobserved channels, gaps, and channels unavailable in the reference frame stay absent.
